source.storyText:
Deeno, Rainbowland's only dragon, wore a pink bow and sang about playing, but he had no one to join him.

One night, a dull, slightly square blue ball dreamed itself into Rainbowland and landed on Deeno's head.

After a wild tumble restored Ball's old shape and color, Deeno showed that friendship mattered more than perfection.

Together, they finished his song.

project.title: Deeno in Rainbowland
project.visualStyle: Cinematic animated fantasy with rounded storybook forms, expressive facial animation, coherent rainbow-themed production design, polished volumetric lighting, soft tactile materials, and natural squash-and-stretch motion. Colors are vivid but harmonized; friendship moments use warm, gentle framing.

entities.name: Deeno
entities.visualDescription: A friendly young dragon with mint-green scales, a cream belly, small lavender wings, rounded horns, large expressive eyes, and a cheerful pink bow at his neck.
entities.continuityNotes: Deeno remains the same size and design throughout; the pink bow stays tied at his neck.

entities.name: Ball
entities.visualDescription: A living blue ball with simple expressive eyes and a small mouth; initially dull blue and slightly square, later round, springy, and bright sapphire blue.
entities.continuityNotes: Keep Ball dull and slightly angular in scene 002; restore the round shape and vivid color during scene 003 and retain them afterward.

entities.name: Pink Bow
entities.visualDescription: A soft satin bow in bright rosy pink with two rounded loops and short tails.
entities.continuityNotes: Worn securely around Deeno's neck in every scene.

locations.name: Rainbow Meadow
locations.visualDescription: A rolling fantasy meadow with turquoise grass, curved rainbow arches, candy-colored flowers, smooth pastel stones, and distant rounded hills beneath a luminous sky.
locations.continuityNotes: Maintain the same central flower clearing and nearby rainbow arch; lighting shifts from sunset to night and then to warm dawn.

narration.text: Deeno, Rainbowland's only dragon, wore a pink bow and sang about playing, but he had no one to join him.

visual.summary: Deeno performs alone in a colorful clearing, then notices the empty meadow around him.
visual.settingDescription: Sunset in the central flower clearing.

actions.description: Deeno gently straightens the bow at his neck.
Deeno sings with open arms, then lowers them as he sees nobody nearby.

camera.subject: Deeno and the empty clearing
camera.description: Begin close enough to read Deeno's enthusiasm, then reveal the broad unoccupied meadow around him.

look.lighting: Warm sunset light with soft rainbow reflections

visual.continuityNotes: Deeno wears the pink bow; the clearing is undisturbed and empty.

narration.text: One night, a dull, slightly square blue ball dreamed itself into Rainbowland and landed on Deeno's head.

visual.summary: Under a starry sky, the dull angular Ball drops into the meadow and lands on Deeno's head.
visual.settingDescription: Night in the same flower clearing beneath a star-filled sky.

actions.description: The dull, slightly square Ball descends from a soft blue glow above Deeno.

actions.manner: with a soft squash and bounce
actions.description: Ball bumps onto Deeno's head as Deeno's eyes widen and his knees buckle.

camera.subject: Ball's descent toward Deeno
camera.description: Track Ball from the glowing sky to the surprised dragon below, ending on the gentle impact.

look.lighting: Cool moonlight with a faint magical blue glow

visual.continuityNotes: Ball is dull blue and slightly square; Deeno's bow remains secure after impact.

transitionIn.description: Quick motion cut into the tumble.

narration.text: After a wild tumble restored Ball's old shape and color, Deeno showed that friendship mattered more than perfection.

visual.summary: Deeno and Ball tumble across the meadow; Ball becomes round and vivid before Deeno welcomes the changed newcomer.
visual.settingDescription: Late night moving toward dawn along a gentle grassy slope.

actions.description: Deeno and Ball roll through soft flowers as Ball smooths into a round shape and brightens to sapphire blue.
Deeno steadies the restored Ball and pulls it into a smiling hug.

camera.movement: Fast lateral track easing into a stop
camera.subject: Deeno and Ball tumbling together
camera.description: Follow their rolling motion, then settle into a close two-shot as Deeno embraces Ball.

look.lighting: Cool moonlight warming with the first peach glow of dawn

visual.continuityNotes: Ball changes from dull and angular to bright, round, and springy during the tumble; Deeno's bow becomes slightly rumpled but stays tied.

transitionIn.description: Soft cut on their shared smile.

visual.summary: At dawn, Deeno sings while Ball bounces beside him in joyful rhythm.
visual.settingDescription: Dawn in the central flower clearing.

actions.description: Deeno sings toward Ball with one arm extended.
Ball springs beside Deeno, smiling as they finish together.

camera.subject: Deeno and Ball performing together
camera.description: Hold both friends in the center as rainbow arches and flowers frame their shared performance.

look.lighting: Warm golden dawn with luminous rainbow highlights

visual.continuityNotes: Ball remains round and vivid blue; Deeno's pink bow remains slightly rumpled from the tumble.

transitionIn.description: Fade out on their smiling pose.
